theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P) (ρ₁ C L : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → ‖v‖ = 1 → 0 < ρ₁ → 0 ≤ C → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₁ → μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) * inner ℝ v (ν z) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z, f (r⁻¹ • (z - y)) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L)
